---- MODULE FlashWithMutex ----
EXTENDS FlashWithMutexDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AgtT == INSTANCE TLAPS

AgtTrk(p) ==
  \/ (Dir.ShrVld /\ p \in Dir.ShrSet)
  \/ (Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr = p)
  \/ p \in Dir.InvSet
  \/ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" /\ ShWbMsg.Proc = p)

AgtTrkD(p) == (Dir.ShrVld /\ p \in Dir.ShrSet) \/ (Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr = p)

AgtTrkH(p) == (Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr = p) \/ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" /\ ShWbMsg.Proc = p)

AgtFwd == \E s \in NODE : (UniMsg[s].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get","UNI_GetX"} /\ UniMsg[s].Proc # Home)

AgtHomePut == UniMsg[Home].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put","UNI_PutX"}

AgtGTy ==
  /\ TypeOK
  /\ \A p \in NODE : Proc[p].CacheState \in {"CACHE_S","CACHE_E"} => Proc[p].CacheData \in DATA
  /\ \A n \in NODE : UniMsg[n].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put","UNI_PutX"} => UniMsg[n].Data \in DATA
  /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" => WbMsg.Proc \in NODE /\ WbMsg.Data \in DATA)
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" => ShWbMsg.Data \in DATA)
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE /\ ShWbMsg.Proc # Home)

AgtGDir ==
  /\ (Dir.HeadVld => Dir.HeadPtr \in NODE)
  /\ (~Dir.HeadVld => Dir.ShrSet = {})
  /\ (~Dir.ShrVld => Dir.ShrSet = {})
  /\ (Dir.ShrVld => Dir.HeadVld)
  /\ (~Dir.HeadVld => ~Dir.ShrVld)
  /\ ((Dir.Dirty /\ Dir.Local) => Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_E")
  /\ (Dir.Dirty => (Dir.Local \/ Dir.HeadVld))
  /\ (Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_E" => (Dir.Dirty /\ Dir.Local))
  /\ ((Dir.Dirty /\ ~Dir.Local) => (Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr # Home))
  /\ (Dir.HeadVld => Dir.HeadPtr # Home)
  /\ Home \notin Dir.ShrSet
  /\ Home \notin Dir.InvSet
  /\ (Dir.Dirty => Dir.ShrSet = {})
  /\ (Dir.Dirty => ~Dir.ShrVld)
  /\ (Proc[Home].CacheState \in {"CACHE_S","CACHE_E"} => Dir.Local)

AgtGCol ==
  /\ InvMsg[Home].Cmd = "INV_None"
  /\ \A p \in NODE : InvMsg[p].Cmd # "INV_None" => (Collecting /\ Dir.Pending /\ p \in Dir.InvSet)
  /\ (Collecting => Dir.Pending)
  /\ (Collecting => ~Dir.ShrVld)
  /\ (Collecting => (\A p \in NODE : (p \in Dir.InvSet) <=> (InvMsg[p].Cmd # "INV_None")))
  /\ (Collecting => Dir.InvSet # {})
  /\ (~Collecting => Dir.InvSet \subseteq Dir.ShrSet)
  /\ \A p \in NODE : InvMsg[p].Cmd = "INV_InvAck" => Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_I"
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (InvMsg[p].Cmd = "INV_InvAck" /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put") => Proc[p].InvMarked
  /\ \A p \in NODE : UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_PutX" => InvMsg[p].Cmd = "INV_None"
  /\ (Collecting => \A q \in NODE : UniMsg[q].Cmd = "UNI_PutX" => (UniMsg[q].Proc = Home /\ PendReqSrc = q))
  /\ (Collecting => \A p \in NODE :
        (Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_S" \/ (p # Home /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked))
          => p \in Dir.InvSet)

AgtGMsg ==
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (Proc[p].ProcCmd # "NODE_None") <=> (UniMsg[p].Cmd # "UNI_None")
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (p # Home /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_PutX") => Proc[p].ProcCmd = "NODE_GetX"
  /\ \A p \in NODE :
       /\ (UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get","UNI_Put"} => Proc[p].ProcCmd = "NODE_Get")
       /\ (UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_GetX","UNI_PutX"} => Proc[p].ProcCmd = "NODE_GetX")
  /\ \A p \in NODE : UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get","UNI_GetX"} => (UniMsg[p].Proc \in NODE /\ UniMsg[p].Proc # p)
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (p # Home /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get","UNI_GetX"}) => Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_I"
  /\ RpMsg[Home].Cmd = "RP_None"
  /\ \A p \in NODE : RpMsg[p].Cmd = "RP_Replace" => UniMsg[p].Cmd # "UNI_Put"
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (RpMsg[p].Cmd = "RP_Replace" /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Get") => UniMsg[p].Proc = Home

AgtGTok ==
  /\ ((Dir.Pending /\ ~Collecting) =>
        (NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_Nakc" \/ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" \/ AgtHomePut \/ AgtFwd))
  /\ (~Dir.Pending => (NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"))
  /\ ((Dir.Pending /\ ~Collecting) => PendReqSrc \in NODE)
  /\ \A s \in NODE : (UniMsg[s].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get","UNI_GetX"} /\ UniMsg[s].Proc # Home)
        => (~Collecting /\ Dir.Pending /\ PendReqSrc = s)
  /\ (NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_Nakc" => (Dir.Pending /\ ~Collecting))
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => (Dir.Pending /\ ~Collecting))
  /\ (AgtHomePut => Dir.Pending)
  /\ (NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_Nakc" => (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None" /\ ~AgtHomePut /\ ~AgtFwd))
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => (NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ~AgtHomePut /\ ~AgtFwd))
  /\ (AgtHomePut => (NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None" /\ ~AgtFwd))
  /\ (Collecting => ~AgtHomePut)

AgtGExc ==
  /\ \A p \in NODE : UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_PutX" =>
       /\ Dir.Dirty
       /\ UniMsg[p].Data = CurrData
       /\ WbMsg.Cmd # "WB_Wb"
       /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_ShWb"
       /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : Proc[q].CacheState # "CACHE_E"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : q # p => UniMsg[q].Cmd # "UNI_PutX"
       /\ (p # Home => ((Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr = p) \/ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_FAck" /\ ShWbMsg.Proc = p)))
  /\ (WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" =>
       /\ Dir.Dirty
       /\ WbMsg.Data = CurrData
       /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_ShWb"
       /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : Proc[q].CacheState # "CACHE_E"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : UniMsg[q].Cmd # "UNI_PutX")
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" =>
       /\ Dir.Dirty
       /\ ShWbMsg.Data = CurrData
       /\ WbMsg.Cmd # "WB_Wb"
       /\ UniMsg[Home].Cmd # "UNI_Put"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : Proc[q].CacheState # "CACHE_E"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : UniMsg[q].Cmd # "UNI_PutX")
  /\ (UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put" =>
       /\ Dir.Dirty
       /\ UniMsg[Home].Data = CurrData
       /\ WbMsg.Cmd # "WB_Wb"
       /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_ShWb"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : Proc[q].CacheState # "CACHE_E"
       /\ \A q \in NODE : UniMsg[q].Cmd # "UNI_PutX")
  /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_FAck" =>
       /\ \A q \in NODE : Proc[q].CacheState = "CACHE_E" => q = ShWbMsg.Proc
       /\ \A q \in NODE : UniMsg[q].Cmd = "UNI_PutX" => q = ShWbMsg.Proc)
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (p # Home /\ Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_E") =>
       ((Dir.HeadVld /\ Dir.HeadPtr = p) \/ (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_FAck" /\ ShWbMsg.Proc = p))
  /\ \A p, q \in NODE : (p # q /\ Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_E" /\ Proc[q].CacheState = "CACHE_S") => Collecting
  /\ \A p, q \in NODE :
       (UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked /\ Proc[q].CacheState = "CACHE_E") => Collecting
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked) =>
       UniMsg[p].Data = (IF Collecting THEN PrevData ELSE CurrData)

AgtGShr ==
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (p # Home /\ Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_S") => AgtTrk(p)
  /\ (~Dir.Pending => \A p \in NODE : (p # Home /\ Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_S") => AgtTrkD(p))
  /\ \A p \in NODE : (p # Home /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked) => AgtTrk(p)
  /\ (~Dir.Pending => \A p \in NODE :
        (p # Home /\ UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked) => AgtTrkD(p))
  /\ \A p \in NODE :
       (/\ p # Home /\ Dir.Dirty /\ p \notin Dir.InvSet
        /\ (Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_S" \/ (UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked)))
       => (ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" \/ UniMsg[Home].Cmd = "UNI_Put")
  /\ \A p \in NODE :
       (/\ RpMsg[p].Cmd = "RP_Replace" /\ Dir.ShrVld
        /\ (Proc[p].CacheState = "CACHE_S" \/ (UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_Put" /\ ~Proc[p].InvMarked)))
       => AgtTrkH(p)
  /\ ((ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" /\ RpMsg[ShWbMsg.Proc].Cmd = "RP_Replace")
        => Proc[ShWbMsg.Proc].CacheState # "CACHE_S")

AgtGPrp ==
  /\ CacheDataProp
  /\ MemDataProp
  /\ Lemma_1
  /\ Lemma_2
  /\ Lemma_3
  /\ Lemma_4

AgtInv ==
  /\ AgtGTy
  /\ AgtGDir
  /\ AgtGCol
  /\ AgtGMsg
  /\ AgtGTok
  /\ AgtGExc
  /\ AgtGShr
  /\ AgtGPrp
